name: Thermax Limited
about: Thermax Limited, together with its subsidiaries, provides energy and environment solutions in India and internationally. The company is involved in the manufacturing, installation, sales, and services related to boilers and heating equipment, absorption chiller/heat pumps, air pollution control equipment/systems, water and waste recycling; and provision of associated services and engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC). It also provides EPC of power plants, infra projects, and flue gas desulphurisation projects; manufactures, installs, sells, and services related to ion exchange resins, performance chemicals, construction chemicals, water treatment chemicals, oil field chemicals, paper and construction chemicals, and related services; and builds, owns and operates models, energy management solutions, oil and gas-fired, green hydrogen project, and solar and wind renewable energy. In addition, the company is involved in the supply and erection commissioning of aircooled condenser, rotary air preheater, electrostatic precipitator, and bag houses; installation of industrial machinery and equipment; investment and flooring chemical businesses; own and lease out property; and manufacturing steam trap systems. Further, it provides technical assistance, marketing and sales support, supervision for project business, and operation and maintenance services, as well as turnkey solutions. It serves agriculture and allied, automobile and auto, components, bio-CNG, biotechnology, brewery and distillery, cement, chemicals, construction, engineering and capital, goods, ethanol, fertiliser and agro, FMCG, food and beverages, healthcare, hospitality, infrastructure, IT and data centres, manufacturing, medical devices, metals, oil and gas, paper and pulp, pharmaceuticals, power, renewable energy, rubber, and semiconductors industries. Thermax Limited was incorporated in 1966 and is headquartered in Pune, India. Thermax Limited is a subsidiary of RDA Holdings Private Limited.
